# Sainik School Guide India

> India's most comprehensive Sainik School directory. AISSEE preparation tips, school information, admission guides, and daily articles for defense aspirants. Updated August 2026.

## Overview

Sainik School Guide India is a free educational resource for parents and students preparing for AISSEE (All India Sainik School Entrance Exam). We cover all 33+ Sainik Schools across India with detailed information on admissions, fees, facilities, and preparation strategies.

**Key Facts:**
- Total Sainik Schools: 33+ traditional + 69 PPP model
- Exam: AISSEE conducted by NTA (National Testing Agency)
- Classes: Class 6 (age 10-12) and Class 9 (age 13-15)
- Exam Frequency: Once a year (January)
- Application Period: October-November
- Official Website: https://exams.nta.nic.in/sainik-school-society/
